facts.text: Stopping-performance sources use inconsistent definitions: UN R152 uses braking demand, ISO 3450 uses mean deceleration from v²/2s, MSHA uses constant deceleration with separate response times, and New South Wales uses net safe deceleration on grade.
facts.quote: The sources mix braking demand (UN R152), mean deceleration from v²/2s (ISO 3450), constant deceleration with separate response times (MSHA), and net safe deceleration on grade (New South Wales).

facts.text: A programme pooling stopping-performance sources into one envelope must first convert the sources to one definition of stopping distance and one time origin.
facts.quote: A programme that pools them into one envelope must first convert them to one definition of stopping distance and one time origin.
